The control shape 1x4096 (tileCount=1, split-phase never fires) shows +1.47%, setting the measurement-bias floor; the large-D excess over that floor is only ~0.6-1.3%. The hypothesis predicted a win (hidden param MTE2 latency); the delivered revision is at best neutral and slightly slower — most likely the extra V_MTE2 SetFlag/WaitFlag pairs (2 per tile on tileCount=8 = 14 extra flag ops) cost at least as much as the latency they hide. Scientific outcome is the important part: with tileElems constant at 4096 the param-MTE2-timing mechanism produces no win, formally falsifying it as the large-D bottleneck.
